title: Reading Quest
subtitle: Short stories to read, then answer.

passages.title: 🐱 The Cat in the Hat
passages.text: Milo is a small cat. He finds a big red hat on the sofa. The hat is too big. Milo walks into the kitchen, but he cannot see. He walks into a chair. The chair is fine. Milo is fine. His hat is on the floor. Now the dog wears it!

questions.q: Who wears the hat at the end?

passages.title: 🍌 The Banana Phone
passages.text: Lina has a yellow banana. She puts it next to her ear. “Hello, Grandma!” she says. Grandma is in the room and laughs. “That is a banana, not a phone!” Lina smiles. “I know. But this phone is delicious.” Then she eats it.

questions.q: What does Lina put by her ear?
What does Lina do at the end?

passages.title: 🐸 A Frog at School
passages.text: A green frog sits on Tom’s desk. Tom says, “Good morning!” The frog jumps onto his book. The teacher comes in. Everyone is quiet. Then the frog says, “Ribbit!” The class laughs. The teacher says, “Our new student is very good at jumping.”

questions.q: What is the frog good at?

passages.title: 🧦 The Missing Sock
passages.text: Omar has two blue socks. In the morning, he sees only one. He looks under his bed. No sock. He looks in his bag. No sock. His little dog runs into the room. The dog has the blue sock on its head. Omar laughs and takes his sock back.

questions.q: How many socks does Omar have?
Where is the sock on the dog?

passages.title: 🍕 Pizza for Breakfast
passages.text: It is Saturday. Dad makes a pizza for breakfast. It has tomato and cheese. Ava puts a little banana on her piece. Dad says, “Banana on pizza?” Ava takes a bite. “Yes! It is sweet and good.” Dad tries it too. He smiles, but Mum wants bread.

passages.title: 🚲 The Slow Race
passages.text: Nina and Leo ride their bikes in the park. “Let’s race!” says Leo. Nina rides fast. Leo rides slowly because a duck family crosses the path. Nina stops and waits with him. The ducks go to the pond. Leo and Nina start again. The ducks win the race!

passages.title: ☔ An Umbrella for the Sun
passages.text: The sky is blue. The sun is hot. Ben takes an umbrella to the park. His friends say, “There is no rain!” Ben opens it and sits in the shade. Soon his friends sit with him. “Good idea,” they say. Then one small cloud brings rain.

questions.q: What is the weather like first?
Why do his friends sit with him?

passages.title: 🐢 Turtle’s Big Day
passages.text: Titi the turtle wants to visit her friend. Her friend lives next to a big tree. Titi walks all morning. At lunch, she sees the tree. “I am here!” she says. Her friend comes out. It is another turtle. “You are early,” says her friend. “I am early?” Titi laughs.

questions.q: When does Titi see the tree?

passages.title: 🎂 The Surprise Cake
passages.text: It is Jo’s birthday. His sister makes a small cake. She puts five candles on it. Jo closes his eyes and makes a wish. When he opens his eyes, the cat is near the cake. There is no cream on top. The cat has cream on its nose. “Happy birthday, cat!” says Jo.

questions.q: What is missing from the cake?

passages.title: 🐘 The Elephant’s Shoes
passages.text: Eli the elephant has four new shoes. They are bright yellow. He walks to the river to show his friends. A fish looks at his feet and says, “Nice shoes!” Eli smiles. Then he steps into the water. His shoes float away. The fish says, “Nice boats!”

questions.q: How many shoes does Eli have?

passages.title: 🥕 The Carrot King
passages.text: A rabbit finds a very big carrot in the garden. It is bigger than his head. He puts it on his head like a crown. “I am the carrot king!” he says. His sister laughs. “A king must share,” she says. The rabbit cuts the carrot in two. They eat together.

questions.q: What do they do at the end?

passages.title: 🚌 The Wrong Bus
passages.text: Maya wants to go to the library. She gets on a bus with a picture of a book. But it is not a library bus. It is a bus for a book shop! The driver smiles. “The library is across the street.” Maya buys no books. She crosses the street and finds the library.

questions.q: Where does Maya want to go?
What picture is on the bus?

passages.title: 🌙 The Moon Is Late
passages.text: Sam looks out of the window at night. He cannot see the moon. “Is the moon late?” he asks his dad. Dad looks up. A big cloud is in front of the moon. The wind moves the cloud. Now the moon is there. “Hello, moon! You are on time,” says Sam.

questions.q: What is in front of the moon?

passages.title: 🐟 A Fish Named Bird
passages.text: Nora has a little fish. Its name is Bird. Bird lives in a round bowl. Nora says, “Bird, can you fly?” Bird swims up and down. “No, but you can dance,” says Nora. Her brother says, “Why is a fish called Bird?” Nora says, “Because it is funny!”

passages.title: 👟 Two Different Shoes
passages.text: Paul gets dressed very fast. He goes to school. His friend points at his feet. One shoe is black. The other shoe is white. Paul looks down and laughs. “My shoes are playing a game,” he says. After school, he finds the other two shoes at home.

questions.q: What color is the other shoe?

passages.title: 🍉 The Watermelon Hat
passages.text: It is a hot day. Dad cuts a watermelon. Amir eats a big piece. The green skin is like a little boat. Amir puts it on his head. “Look! A watermelon hat!” Dad laughs. “Take it off before we go to the shop.” Amir says, “But everyone will want one!”

questions.q: What does Amir put on his head?
Where do they plan to go?

passages.title: 🦜 The Parrot Says No
passages.text: A parrot lives with Ana. Every day Ana says, “Good morning!” The parrot says, “No!” Ana asks, “Do you want an apple?” The parrot says, “No!” But it eats the apple. One day Ana says, “Do you want to clean your cage?” The parrot says, “Good morning!”

questions.q: What word does it often say?
What does Ana ask it to clean?

passages.title: 🎒 A Bag Full of Socks
passages.text: Ema is ready for school. Her bag is very heavy. She opens it in class. There are ten socks inside! There is no book. Her little brother put the socks in the bag. Ema laughs. The teacher gives her paper. At home, Ema gives the socks back to her brother.

questions.q: How many socks are in the bag?
What is not in the bag?

passages.title: 🐓 The Sleepy Rooster
passages.text: A rooster lives on a farm. Every morning, he calls, “Cock-a-doodle-doo!” Today he is sleepy. He says nothing. The farmer wakes up late. The cows wait for breakfast. At noon, the rooster opens one eye and calls. The cows say, “Good afternoon!”

passages.title: 🍦 Ice Cream for a Dog
passages.text: It is a warm afternoon. Sira buys strawberry ice cream. Her dog looks at it. “This is mine,” says Sira. She buys a small cup of water for the dog. The dog drinks it happily. Sira takes one bite of her ice cream. Oh no! It falls on her shoe.

questions.q: What flavor is the ice cream?
What does Sira do with the ice cream?
options: She gives it all to the dog
She puts it in a bag

passages.title: 🦒 The Giraffe’s Scarf
passages.text: Zaza the giraffe has a long neck. Her friend makes a blue scarf for her. It is very long. Zaza puts it on, but a little bird sits on the scarf. “Is this a new nest?” asks the bird. “No, it is my scarf,” says Zaza. “You can sit here for one minute.”

questions.q: How long may the bird sit there?

passages.title: 🪥 The Toothbrush Song
passages.text: Kai brushes his teeth every morning. Today he sings a song while he brushes. His sister hears him. “Why are you singing?” she asks. Kai says, “My toothbrush is a microphone!” He sings so loudly that Dad comes to the door. Dad says, “Good song. Now rinse your mouth.”

questions.q: What does Kai do every morning?
What does he use as a microphone?
What does Dad tell him to do?

passages.title: 🪁 The Kite That Sat Down
passages.text: Ruby has a green kite. She runs in the park. The kite flies high. Then the wind stops. The kite comes down and lands on a bench. Ruby sits next to it. “Are you tired?” she asks. The wind comes back. The kite flies again. Ruby runs after it.

passages.title: 🥚 The Egg on the Chair
passages.text: Nico sees an egg on a chair in the kitchen. “Who put it there?” he asks. His mother says, “Not me.” His brother says, “Not me.” The chicken walks in through the open door. She sits on the chair. “Oh,” says Nico. “It is your chair!”

passages.title: 🎨 The Blue Sun
passages.text: At school, Mia draws a blue sun. Her friend asks, “Why is the sun blue?” Mia says, “I only have a blue pencil.” The teacher gives her a yellow pencil. Mia draws a yellow bird next to the blue sun. “Now the bird has the sun’s color,” she says. Everyone laughs.

options: She has only a blue pencil

questions.q: What does the teacher give her?

passages.title: 🐒 Monkey’s Quiet Game
passages.text: Momo the monkey plays a quiet game with his friends. No one can make a sound. A bird sings. Momo smiles but stays quiet. A leaf falls on his nose. He wants to laugh. Then his friend gives him a banana. “Thank you!” says Momo. His friends clap. He loses the game, but wins a snack.

questions.q: What kind of game do they play?
